name: shopify-rich-text-editor
description: Reusable Shopify App rich text editor workspace with React, Tiptap, Polaris, and server-side Shopify HTML rendering.
author: Standhigher

scripts.pack:dry-run: pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor exec npm pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server exec npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:check: pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm pack:dry-run
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor-demo version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version major --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor-demo version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version minor --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor-demo version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:publish: pnpm release:check && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor exec npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server exec npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
